data.title: 五更琉璃 · 图书馆书架前牛仔短裙的垫脚偶遇
data.description: 阳光静谧的市立图书馆，琉璃换上罕见的甜美夏日便装——白色短袖泡泡袖上衣配牛仔半裙，踮起双脚伸手够取高层书架上的轻小说。
data.location: 藏书丰富的安静图书馆过道
data.action: 双足踮起伸展右臂够取高处的书籍，白色短袖微微上提露出一截白皙纤腰，察觉到目光回眸羞嗔
data.lighting: 百叶窗透入的一道道斑马条纹阳光，木质书架充满书香氛围
data.camera: 仰视近全景，突出娇小身材与偶遇的心动瞬间
data.promptProse: Kuroneko browses the quiet aisles of the municipal library on a bright summer afternoon, dressed in an uncharacteristically sweet casual outfit featuring a white puff-sleeve crop blouse and a high-waisted denim skirt. Standing on her tiptoes with one arm outstretched toward a high bookshelf, her top lifts slightly to reveal her fair waist. Startled by approaching footsteps, she turns around with a sharp, defensive blush.
data.animaCaption: Reaching on tiptoes for a high volume among the library bookshelves, Kuroneko turns with a flustered, startled blush.
